title: Remove the Back Bar and Embed the Mask Eyes
objective: Delete the accidental ShellSeam bar and refine the two glowing eye blocks into thin mask-integrated slits while preserving the accepted striped exoskeleton, beetle anatomy, locomotion, and gameplay.
acceptance: Body/ShellSeam and its obsolete mesh resource are removed with no renamed back bar, handle, or floating ridge replacement
EyeLeft and EyeRight remain separated emissive BoxMesh descendants of Mask with width 0.06–0.13, height at most 0.045, and depth at most 0.014
each eye slit intersects the mask front plane and projects no more than the shallow trusted tolerance, reading as an embedded opening rather than a pasted-on cube
the dark mask/head and amber slit eyes clearly communicate the face and forward direction without realistic, cartoon, or robotic extra anatomy
TB-R04B no-Shirt topology, Z-driven striped Thorax ShaderMaterial, stripe contrast/count, and separately dark rear Abdomen remain unchanged in concept and visually readable
six articulated Upper/Lower legs, two antennae, squat dung-beetle identity, grounded gait, and Body/Thorax/Abdomen articulation remain intact
movement, collision, camera, interaction, collection, HUD, exit progression, completion, restart, and all levels remain unchanged
TB-001 through TB-R04B regressions with TB-H01 stabilization, front/rear/gameplay renders, Linux export, and all exported levels pass
only scenes/player.tscn and, if strictly necessary, scripts/player.gd change; no level, locomotion, gameplay, external asset, or unrelated refinement is included
